741310301.text: I've sent someone to give your report to the Institute. In any case, I shall leave the upcoming work to you, Ms. Fusilier.

741310302.text: Of course, Mr. Raimondo. But about the help you mentioned...

741310303.text: Don't worry. When the right time comes, our Honorary Senior Researcher will...

741310306.text: It's great to see you so soon, Honorary Senior Researcher and the Assistant to the Honorary Senior Researcher. Oh, allow me to introduce...

741310307.text: This is the special investigator in charge of the stolen Arkhium Kinetic Core case, Miss Fusilier.

741310308.text: Before I ask for your help again, please allow me to briefly explain the case of the Arkhium Kinetic Core's theft.

741310310.text: Raimondo briefly explains why the Fontaine Research Institute initially identified Nacker as the prime suspect.

741310311.text: An intense surge of Arkhium energy would have filled the Central Laboratory after the explosion, so only professionals could've engaged in work there for any length of time.

741310312.text: And the timing of the Experimental Field Generator's activation and attack was too much of a coincidence. According to Raimondo, the suspect must be a senior researcher linked to the research, and subsequent examinations and reenactments of the events have borne this theory out...

741310313.text: The only people capable of this in Fontaine Research Institute are Raimondo, Nacker, and Edwin, the last of whom passed away during the explosion. Raimondo mentions that he too is under internal review... and it sounds like a huge pain...

741310314.text: However, locating the Core as soon as possible still remains your main objective... The unstable prototype may go out of control at any moment and release a surge of Arkhium that would affect everything around it...

741310315.text: Hey! Doesn't that mean it might explode again at any moment!?

741310601.text: What are we doing here? We look like eavesdroppers...

741310602.text: Well, we are here to be eavesdroppers. But I think we have to wait a little longer... Let's get behind those shrubs for now.

741310603.text: You wait for some time behind in the shrubbery...

741310604.text: Look over there. Those are the people we're waiting for.

741310605.text: According to my investigation, they're reselling a batch of goods linked to the Fontaine Research Institute.

741310606.text: And this may be connected to Nacker... Let's get closer.

subQuests.subQuestName: Stay quiet and listen for clues

741310803.text: Mr. Chaussivert, it seems you don't know the rules. I suppose that's as far as my warnings go. Farewell.

741310804.text: You pretentious... Let's go! Take those snoops out!

741311001.text: Fine... You're good. It's my loss.

741311002.text: It doesn't matter who hired you to silence me. Just do as you please.

741311003.text: Huh? No one's trying to silence you! Actually... We're hoping you'll talk.

741311004.text: We're special investigators from Fontaine Research Institute. Mr. Chaussivert, we suspect that you're involved in the disappearance of our Arkhium Kinetic Core. Please cooperate with our investigation.

741311005.text: So the Institute seeks assistance in their investigation by hiding and eavesdropping? Why am I not surprised?

741311006.text: Th—That's just a necessary investigative technique. Allow me to explain...

741311007.text: Fusilier gives Chaussivert a detailed account of everything. He doesn't seem to fully understand her, however...

741311008.text: I don't understand... Lemarcq, what the devil is all of this?

741311009.text: I think she's trying to tell you that some idiot stole something from the Institute, and that thing might explode at any moment.

741311010.text: If it explodes near Lumidouce Harbor, it'll kill all the fish there and render it impassable to ships.

741311011.text: So they're here to get that idiot. That's what you were trying to say, right?

741311012.text: Your summary is correct. I guess there is someone here with brain cells to rub together, after all.

741311013.text: I see... So you're here to do good, then. And here I was, thinking that that blasted Loillier had sent you to silence me.

741311014.text: Hmph! I misunderstood you. It's my mistake, so drinks are on me next time.

741311015.text: Silence you? Weren't you discussing a business deal?

741311016.text: A deal? Hahahaha! Looks like this misunderstanding's mutual... I would never do business with trash like Loillier.

741311017.text: He's always with the Snezhnayans, and all he cares about is transporting Fontaine's goods to the outside for his own benefit. He's as bad as they get.

741311018.text: Some time ago, he came asking for my help in smuggling a person out of Fontaine on the down low.

741311019.text: To smuggle someone out? Could it be...!?

741311020.text: Yes, it could be Nacker, the one we're looking for. What happened next, Mr. Chaussivert?

741311021.text: Hmm. He looked to be up to no good, so I turned him down.

741311023.text: Is it just Paimon, or do you seem a bit... disappointed, Miss Fusilier...?

741311024.text: Huh? What? I—I'm not! How could I possibly hope that someone might commit a crime? No way...

741311025.text: Today, he came all the way to threaten me, telling me not to leak out any information regarding this incident, or else his boss Concini would personally come to teach me a lesson.

741311026.text: I was just about to teach HIM a lesson when Lemarcq noticed you eavesdropping, and the guy seized the chance and fled... I guess I'll just have to wait until the next time he and I meet.

741311027.text: So this Loillier's boss is called Concini...

741311028.text: Hmm... Paimon's never heard of him. C—Could he be a Fatuus?

741311029.text: Uh, never mind, Paimon's just joking! There's no way that everyone from Snezhnaya who we've met is a Fatuus... Hahaha...

741311030.text: I used to think that way, too, but I really don't know what's going on with that Concini guy from Snezhnaya.

741311031.text: All I know is that he's a major buyer, and he's been purchasing all kinds of goods and equipment and sending them to the harbor. I have no idea what kind of business he's involved in.

741311032.text: That said, since he's associating with the likes of Loillier, he's definitely no better.

741311033.text: Boss, this is not the place to talk. Let's head back to the ship first.

741311034.text: Right. You, come with me. You're looking for that "core" thing or whatever, right? I'll help you with it.

741311035.text: Heh? What a surprise! And I thought there was gonna be a twist.

741311036.text: You... You're not planning to kill us onboard and dump our bodies in the sea, are you?!

741311037.text: This entire Lumidouce Harbor is under my protection. Anyone causing trouble around here is my business.

741311038.text: If what you said is true, then I'm doing the right thing. If not, at least Lumidouce Harbor will avoid disaster. Don't you understand that at the very least?

741311040.text: Enough chit-chat. You want to talk? Get on the ship and talk.

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow Chaussivert back onto the ship

741311201.text: Wow... Do you own the entire ship?

741311202.text: Of course it's mine. Now, let's get on with business. That thing might go off at any second, right? There's not a moment to lose.

741311203.text: But... We don't have anything else to go on. Based on what we know so far, you run the largest underground trading operation in Lumidouce Harbor and often deal in items related to the Institute.

741311204.text: During our investigations at the harbor, our investigators found trace amounts of Arkhium energy reactions on some goods. We believe that Nacker may have come through here with the core...

741311205.text: That's why we came to you, following the trade leads, but we didn't expect to find out that...

741311207.text: Hmph! The gray market is not the same as the black market... I'm not a parasite like Loillier.

741311208.text: Hey! You just said you're in the gray market. Get off your high horse!

741311212.text: If you'd only came to me sooner... I'd have captured that Loillier guy! He said he's gonna teach me a lesson? That, I can't wait to see.

741311210.text: Hey, that's like saying "You lack creativity in your criminal activities"!

741311211.text: Hahaha! Well, I'm certainly not a parasite like Loillier.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for Covault at The Rusty Rudder

741311401.text: *cough* *cough* A person could choke on this alcoholic reek...

741311402.text: There are so many drunks in here... Can we really find this Covault guy?

741311404.text: With his financial state and moral standards, "home" is a luxury he can't afford.

741311405.text: He has nowhere else to be except the tavern.

741311409.text: Just to be on the safe side, let's stay together. The people in this watering hole aren't the friendliest.

741311410.text: Especially you, Institute lady. Don't stray too far from me. These drunkards might try to rob you, given how fragile you seem.

741311411.text: Then they will have the privilege of witnessing the power of our proud creations.

741311412.text: Mr. Edwin instructed me on how to modify this meka. The energy beam it emits can easily incapacitate a person.

741311413.text: Paimon and I will try our luck over there.

741311414.text: Alright, let's go. I'll take the lead. Lemarcq, you watch our flanks.

741311407.text: Then, we can only hope that he passed out somewhere in the wild and met his end.

741311408.text: In any case, let's at least be civil enough to go look for him.

741314701.text: Have you seen a guy called Covault?

741314702.text: Sure. He just bought another round for everyone before stumbling out the door.

741314703.text: Humph... I wonder where he got all that money.

741311501.text: Heheh... I'm gonna be rich... How dare you belittle me... Burp.

741311502.text: That's him. There's no one else in Lumidouce Harbor with a rat-face like that.

741311504.text: Wh—Who are you? I'm in the money now... Don't... Don't you dare shout at me!

741311505.text: Oh, sure. So where did you get it? Details, if you please.

741311507.text: You... It's all because I worked for you... that I missed out on making big money!

741311701.text: B—Boss! Chaussivert! Please forgive me, big man!

741311702.text: Forgive you? Well, that depends on your behavior.

741311703.text: Lemarcq, tie him up and take him back to the ship!

741315901.text: Sober yet, Covault? Can you speak properly now?

741315902.text: B—Boss! Chaussivert! I—I... Please forgive me... That was the alcohol talking...

741315905.text: You... You're right, right. Whatever you say!

741315906.text: I ask you a question, you give me an answer. Anything more or less, I knock your teeth out. Clear?

741315908.text: First question. Were you hired by Loillier?

741315911.text: Yes, yes! He hired me to escort someone to a certain location in Lumidouce Harbor. I don't know who the person is. I just escorted him to the designated location, took the money, and got out of there!

741315912.text: Second question. This person you were escorting, was he carrying something?

741315913.text: Well, he had a large backpack on his back, and nobody was allowed to look at it... But... it was very strange. It was warm, and it kept on buzzing...

741315915.text: It's the self-heating effect generated by bound Arkhium. Mr. Edwin's talked about it before. The backpack must contain the Arkhium Kinetic Core.

741315916.text: And the person must be Nacker.

741315201.text: Wait. Now that we've gone far enough, what does your device say, Little Miss Institute?

741315202.text: No reaction... at all. There is no residual Arkhium energy here.

741315203.text: Strange. I've already tuned its sensitivity up to max, and Arkhium energy flow doesn't dissipate that easily...

741315204.text: This prototype was made by Mr. Edwin himself... There's no way it doesn't work...

741315205.text: Huh? H—How come they... and those meka behind them...

741315206.text: I knew it. Pattyn, how much did Loillier promise you?

741315207.text: An amount I'd never earn slaving under you in a lifetime. It's nothing personal, Chaussivert. But I have mouths to feed.

741315208.text: Don't you feel dirty getting mixed up with the likes of Loillier, taking his money like that?

741315209.text: Hehehe... Boss, we all roll in the same mud puddle. The money we earn? It's never clean.

741315210.text: You're the only one riding your high horse, saying "this business is no good, that business harms people," like you're some kinda saint.

741315211.text: In the end, you earn no money and win no people. Only a fool like Lemarcq would stay loyal to you.

741315212.text: We've sailed together for a long time. I'm sure Morgen will make his death painless.

741315213.text: No... Oh no! Mr. Lemarcq is still on the ship!

741315214.text: Don't worry. He has the Pneumousia Ray Self-Defense Device, which was personally modified by Mr. Edwin himself. He'll be fine.

741315218.text: Hmph... Come on, Covault, hurry up and take care of them. Loillier's money is waiting for us to claim it.

741315219.text: Stop telling me what to do! You... Go on, get them!

741315217.text: I'm just confident in Mr. Edwin!

741315301.text: Please meet Miss Fusilier there as soon as possible. She will brief you on the latest information.

741315302.text: Don't mind me saying this, but the situation at Lumidouce Harbor is... delicate. Please be extra careful when handling matters there.

741314201.text: So... Those three are all in league with each other?

741314202.text: That Concini guy is like the owner of a restaurant, getting Loillier to find a chef to cook for Nacker...

741314203.text: I told Loillier to beat it, so he went and found someone else to work for him... And then, he wanted to silence me...

741314204.text: Hmm, it feels like someone who messed up trying to cover their own mistake.

741314205.text: Huh, I see! Well, that certainly does sound like the right amount of trashy for Loillier! You may be little, but you're quite brainy, you know?

741314206.text: Hey, you can keep the first part of the sentence to yourself! Anyway, now we're sure that Nacker is in Lumidouce Harbor, and we've narrowed down the search area by quite a bit.

741314207.text: (But things are never that simple, are they...)

741314208.text: Ahem... Boss, we better interrogate them to see if they have any useful information.

741314209.text: Hm, good idea. Pattyn, you know the rules, yes?

741314211.text: Good. At least you accept the consequences of your own actions. Lemarcq, tie him and Morgen up real good.

741314212.text: Go to your cabins and rest. And remember to put on some earplugs... Let's just say that this won't be a silent night.

741314213.text: After some contemplation, you decide to sit down and rest. In the middle of the night, you are awakened by strange muffled noises and the sound of something heavy falling into the water outside of your cabin. Did something or someone fall into the water? Should you go help? Wait. Chaussivert warned you that this will not be a silent night...

741314214.text: You walk to the door and grab the handle. The commotion outside has quieted down by now, and only the muffled sound of waves hesitantly lapping against the hull remains as you stand hesitantly before the door. What awaits outside? A question? An answer? Regardless, with just a twist of your wrist, you can verify... certain thoughts of yours, can't you?

741314215.text: You hesitate. Despite already having the answer, you still want to ask for Fusilier's opinion. You turn around and see how Fusilier is trying to cover her ears, pretending to be fast asleep.

741314216.text: In the end, you suppress your and Paimon's curiosity and decide to not investigate. You just hope that this night will pass quickly...

741312201.text: I hope you're well-rested. Pattyn and Morgen have told us everything.

741312202.text: How? They were all bent on killing us not so long ago...

741312203.text: Well, that you don't need to know, Little Miss Institute. Lemarcq, tell them.

741312204.text: Aye, aye. To put it simply, with their cooperation, we have learned that two shipments will be delivered to a certain location today...

741312205.text: Unfortunately, those two don't know the precise location. All they know is the time when the shipments will arrive at the shore.

741312208.text: I have an idea. We may be able to find some clues using this energy flow detector.

741312209.text: If that place is indeed where Nacker is hiding, then people going in and out will carry traces of Arkhium energy.

741312210.text: Ooh! That means that all we have to do is to use this device, and "beep beep beep" — we'll know exactly where to go!

741312211.text: What do you mean, "beep beep beep"? Only those obsolete relics do that! I'm using the latest, silent model.

741312212.text: Beeping or not, this is a good shout. No time to waste. Let's move.

741312214.text: They've gone back to where all sailors come from. No need to worry about them... Anchors aweigh!

741315501.text: We're almost there... It seems like the shipment hasn't arrived yet.

741315502.text: Let's wait here for a bit. Keep your ears sharp. They might show up any second.

741315503.text: Everyone finds a place to hide and waits for the couriers to arrive...

741315504.text: Look over there! Are those the people we're waiting for?

741315505.text: Must be. They seem to be handing off the shipment... They'll definitely start transporting it soon.

741315506.text: Why are we eavesdropping again? But this time, we're eavesdropping on the Treasure Hoarders...

741315507.text: This is how the Institute does things.

741315509.text: Let's follow him. But be careful, don't get caught again.

741314001.text: Wh—Who are you? What are you doing here!?

741314002.text: Tsk. You've found me. You've got a keen nose.

741314003.text: We'll leave the thinking to you, Miss Institute Lady. You're the brains, and we're the brawn, after all.

741314004.text: Huh...? Hey! Wait! What do you mean by that?

741313101.text: Loillier, blast him... He's already paid the bulk of the payment, but he can't afford the rest!?

741313102.text: Chill, man. We're all underdogs here. Don't blame the messenger.

741313108.text: W—Wait! Stop! How much is Loillier paying you? I'll pay you the same amount!

741313109.text: Or, how about this: Let me live, and I'll take Loillier out and grab his money, and then we can split the cash?

741313110.text: There's no need for any of that. I just have a few questions for it.

741313111.text: Answer them to my satisfaction, you live — or your head will roll.

741313113.text: Loillier hired you to get the shipments here — that's it? Did he say who they're for?

741313114.text: I... I don't know. All Loillier said was to leave the shipments here, and that someone else would come pick them up.

741313115.text: The previous two runs were exactly like that, just at different locations...

741313116.text: I once stayed behind to see who the buyer was, but they didn't show. Another group of people took the shipment and headed that way. I dared not linger any longer, so I took off.

741313118.text: Good enough. Get out of here. You'd better stay away from Loillier. He's up to no good.

741313120.text: No need. Let him go and cause some trouble for Loillier. So, he said that someone would come to pick the shipments up, hmm?

741313121.text: Institute Lady, it's time for you to get that device of yours beeping. We need to move.

741313122.text: Didn't I say that this is the latest model, and it doesn't beep?

741313105.text: Wh—Why are you asking me? And, what's with the "ma'am"? I'm not part of this outfit!

741313107.text: Sure! Heheh, just watch Paimon... Hmmm... How many strands of hair should she pull?

subQuests.subQuestName: Search ahead for the shipment's delivery point
Continue searching for the shipment's delivery point
Look for clues around the house

741313601.text: The readings... are high. There are clear residual energy readings from all around this house...

741313602.text: Nacker... Why would he go through all the trouble to build a house here?

741313605.text: The lock on this door doesn't seem too sturdy. I think I can break it open. Stand back.

741313606.text: Hey, don't just bash the door in! It might be someone's home... You know, that got irradiated for some reason...

741313607.text: If that's the case, we'll compensate them. It's your investigation, so the money should come out of the Institute, naturally.

741313609.text: What are you doing in my house?

741313611.text: Wait, you're not Nacker... But you're wearing the Institute's uniform...

741313612.text: You're here to deliver the supplies, aren't you? Just leave the things at the back of the house. Can't you read the note on the door?

741313615.text: How do you know me? Tsk... Did Loillier leak my name?

741313616.text: No matter. Just hurry and get me the supplies. The suppressor will be ready soon... Hmm? Why are you staring at me?

741313617.text: Paimon must be seeing things from flying too fast...

741314901.text: No... It's not my fault... I didn't want this... It's not me...

741314903.text: You... Oh. You're not here for me? Great... I didn't do anything wrong... Forgive me! I'm trying... I'll do better... *sobs*

741315001.text: More... more! Who's drinking with me? You... You! You drink with me!

741315002.text: Covault, cut it with the drinking!

741315003.text: Who... Who? Never heard of him! You drink? You no drink? Whatever... I drink!

741315801.text: ...What is it? Go do your thing.

741310201.text: I've sent someone to give your report to the Institute. In any case, I shall leave the upcoming work to you, Ms. Fusilier.

741310202.text: Of course, Mr. Raimondo. But about the help you mentioned...

741310203.text: Don't worry. When the right time comes, our Honorary Senior Researcher will...

741310206.text: It's great to see you so soon, Honorary Senior Researcher and the Assistant to the Honorary Senior Researcher. Oh, allow me to introduce...

741310207.text: This is the special investigator in charge of the stolen Arkhium Kinetic Core case, Miss Fusilier.

741310208.text: You are already aware of the circumstances of said case, so I won't be repeating them. In short, Mr. Nacker is the prime suspect right now.

741310209.text: Presently, we've discovered subtle clues in the Arkhium near Lumidouce Harbor, and... evidence that proves Mr. Nacker is still alive.

741310210.text: If we follow these clues to the end, I'm certain that our suspicions about Mr. Nacker will be proven.

741310211.text: But our main objective is still to retrieve the Arkhium Kinetic Core as soon as possible. It's an extremely unstable prototype.

741310212.text: If our dear Mr. Nacker's practically empty head suddenly has the bright idea of attempting to modify said core...

741310213.text: Maybe we'll get to enjoy another grand fireworks show somewhere...

741310214.text: Wh—Wh—What!? Are you trying to say that it might explode!?

741310216.text: #{NICKNAME}! I—It seems we don't have a choice. Looks like Nacker really does deserve a good beating!

741315601.text: Why are you... You're back again. Told you. You can make five rounds of the place, and you still won't find him.

741315602.text: It's not working out for you, clearly, so why don't you just sit down and have some tea? I just bought five cups... and a few bowls.

741315603.text: You really like the number "five," don't you, Mr. Edwin?

741315604.text: Yes! It's a magical number! Use it right, and you can unlock the doors to endless inspiration!

741315605.text: Listen up. There are five doors to endless inspiration, and you have to turn each handle five times... Five! You hear? Five times!

741315606.text: Sorry, but I'm really trying to stop myself from punching you five times. Would you please kindly shut your trap?

741310101.text: We must resolve this quickly, Raimondo. I'm sure you're aware of the situation at the Institute right now.

741310102.text: If Miss Fusilier's information is reliable, then the rest won't be a problem. However, we'll need to get some help...

741310104.text: Ah, Honorary Senior Researcher! It's so good to see you!

741310105.text: #I won't deny the truth of your words, {NICKNAME}. Still, I believe that you will make this "evil" into good.

741310109.text: Hoo boy, back to the world of meaningless, endless civilities, huh?

741310110.text: Just point to the point. You mentioned needing help... Are you planning to send us on errands again?

741310111.text: #Please come over here, {NICKNAME}. I have a document I wish to show you.

741310112.text: A—Another explosion!? That tiny little core can explode too!?

741310113.text: But according to this document... Nacker is alive, and... You've almost found him?

741310114.text: That is incorrect. It's still possible that Mr. Nacker has apologized for his deeds with his life.

741310115.text: All I can say is that... our previous hypotheses are being confirmed, one after the other.

741310107.text: Oh, Honorary Senior Researcher! It's so good to see you.

741310108.text: #Perfect timing, {NICKNAME}. You do indeed have an extraordinary sense for such honors.

741312101.text: Hmm... This device sure is handy.

741312102.text: Hmm... Looks like Lemarcq just took care of that guy all by himself...

741312103.text: Boss, you're back. Looks like you were ambushed, too. That means...

741312104.text: Loillier has bought both Pattyn and Morgen off. Covault was to lead us into an ambush.

741312107.text: Wait a second. If they were bought off by Loillier, then what about when you were talking to him...?

741312108.text: Hmm. That can only mean that he had that meeting so he could eliminate me. Hmph. Brutal, but that sounds like him, alright.

741312109.text: Then I suppose it's a good thing that you lot came out of the blue to mess with their plans.

741312110.text: Otherwise, given the narrow space... we might not have made it out alive.

741312111.text: Still, they've attacked us twice in a row now. Could they have something to hide?

741314801.text: Drink up! More... Heheheh... Another Bulle Fruit... Put it... on my tab...

741314803.text: Who... Who's that? Who's... Covault!? Ah, move aside!

741315103.text: I... I'm talking to... the Romaritime Flower... Who's Covault?

741315104.text: You... You're also Romaritime Flower? What a... coincidence! Hoohoohoo...

741315401.text: Lumidouce Harbor... I remember that Doutey used to be in charge there. He seems to have found a way to be assigned elsewhere, though...

741315402.text: The person in charge right now should be Cassigneul... With a woman like her around, there's no way I'd ever do business in Lumidouce Harbor.

741315701.text: You go with Chaussivert and try to find this guy. I'll stay here and guard the ship alongside Morgen.

741315702.text: I even borrowed that device from the Institute Lady. The ship will be in good hands.

741316002.text: Oh, him? I just saw him stumble out the door. Not sure which direction he was heading in, though...

741316003.text: I can't remember, but he's not in the tavern, that's for sure.

741316102.text: That drunkard? He went outside to sober up. If you're here for some money he owes you, you're wasting your time.

741316103.text: Judging by how much he's had to drink... he's probably in a bush somewhere, trying to remember his own name.

741316301.text: Hmph... A job that doesn't make you any Mora...

741319901.text: What are we doing here? We look like eavesdroppers...

741319902.text: Well, we are here to be eavesdroppers. But I think we have to wait a little longer... Let's get behind those shrubs for now.

741319903.text: Look over there. Those are the people we're waiting for.

741319904.text: According to my investigation, they're reselling a batch of goods linked to the Fontaine Research Institute.

741319905.text: And this may be connected to Nacker... Let's get closer.

741319913.text: Mr. Chaussivert, it seems you don't know the rules. I suppose that's as far as my warnings go. Farewell.

741319914.text: You pretentious... Lemarcq, Morgen, Pattyn, let's get them!

741319921.text: Well, we know that Covault has left, but where is he?

741319926.text: B—Boss! Chaussivert! Please forgive me, big man!

741319927.text: Forgive you? Well, that depends on your behavior.

741319928.text: Lemarcq, tie him up and take him back to the ship!

741319929.text: Boss, we're close. We just need to head further in.

741319936.text: You think you can take me down by hiring a few Treasure Hoarders? You underestimate me, Covault.

741319937.text: Tsk... What's with you guys!? Go get him! Whoever takes him down gets double!

741319938.text: You... Stay away from me! Or I'm gonna hit you! This device is pretty sturdy, you know!

741319939.text: #Get behind me, Institute Lady! {NICKNAME}, let's clean up this trash!

741319944.text: Someone snitched...! Who are you!? Who sent you!?

741319945.text: Loillier sends his regards. The shipment has been delivered, and you've outlived your usefulness.

741319946.text: Just to save the last bit of payment? That penny pincher!

741319948.text: The signals are getting stronger... We're close!

741319949.text: Look over there! Am I mistaken or is that... a house?

741319950.text: Smoke is coming out of its chimney. Someone's living in there. Stay sharp — I'll take point.

741319951.text: With Chaussivert at the helm, the ship quickly arrives near The Rusty Rudder.

741319955.text: Restrained by Chaussivert, Covault is hauled back to the ship...

741319956.text: Chaussivert takes the helm, and you rush to the pick-up point that Covault mentioned.

741319957.text: Chaussivert takes the helm again, and you rush to the pick-up point.
